start: Member with a plan asked a trainer a question; trainer replies in the panel

user_sees: The push, and at once a red count on the Gym tab and on the 'Message your gym' row
must_not: The same reply popped up again by the 15-minute check

user_sees: The reply; the red count goes
must_not: The count still on the Gym tab after the reply was opened

start: The reply's push was missed (phone off or the push lost)

steps.action: Wait for the 15-minute check with the app closed
user_sees: One pop-up with the gym's name and the trainer's reply; the count on the Gym tab
must_not: A pop-up while 'Messages from your gym' is off

steps.action: Open the app after some time away
user_sees: The count asked again (at most every 5 minutes)

start: Member who may not see the row (no plan) or a gym server without 0053

steps.action: Trainer replies to a question asked while the plan ran
user_sees: No red count on the Gym tab
must_not: A count with no row to open it

steps.action: Open the app with no internet
user_sees: The count stays as it was

start: Count after leave and rejoin, and after a second reply

steps.action: Open a reply, then the trainer replies again
must_not: The new reply counted as read because an older one was opened

steps.action: Leave the gym and join again
user_sees: The count starts at 0 for the new membership
must_not: The old count on the new gym

steps.action: A reply pops up while the phone is locked
user_sees: The gym's name and the reply text in the notification
must_not: The pop-up after the member turned 'Messages from your gym' off
